title: Oven-Roasted Australian Cauliflower Roast
description: A mustardy, velvety roast of cauliflower with ginger garlic paste, finished with cashews and parsley for a festive vegan treat.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk together olive oil, mustard, ginger garlic paste, tamari, maple syrup, coconut milk, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Toss cauliflower florets with the sauce until evenly coated.
Spread the florets in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until edges are golden and florets are tender.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with chopped cashews and lemon zest.
Transfer the roast to a serving dish and garnish with fresh parsley.
Drizzle any remaining sauce over the top before serving.
Serve hot as a main or side with your choice of grains or salad.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
